2.source: relic set 326 (City of Converging Stars), 2-piece ability Ability53261: "When the wearer uses Follow-Up ATK, increases ATK by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s). When an enemy target gets defeated, increases CRIT DMG for all allies by #3[i]% in the current battle. This effect cannot stack." param = [0.24, 2, 0.12]
2.note: #1[i] -> percent = 0.24 (24% ATK), #2[i] -> turns = 2. 'actor == self' is the wearer: FOLLOW_UP carries the one who used the follow-up as actor and the victim as target, so this fires only for the wearer's own follow-up attacks and not for an ally's. No hit_count condition is used because a follow-up is a single settled instance, not an attack that expands into hits -- the event itself is already gated on the instance having connected. 'This effect cannot stack' is the default behaviour of MODIFY_ATTR: re-applying the same kind replaces and resets the duration rather than accumulating, which is exactly what the text asks for.

2.source: relic set 326 (City of Converging Stars), 2-piece ability Ability53261: "When the wearer uses Follow-Up ATK, increases ATK by #1[i]% for #2[i] turn(s). When an enemy target gets defeated, increases CRIT DMG for all allies by #3[i]% in the current battle. This effect cannot stack." param = [0.24, 2, 0.12]
2.note: The second half of the same ability. #3[i] -> percent = 0.12 on CRIT_ATTACK, which is a ratio attribute, so the value is the bonus itself (12 percentage points) rather than a multiplier on it. No 'when' condition: the text says 'when an enemy target gets defeated', with no restriction on who defeated it, and the table already belongs to the wearer. 'target: all_allies' is 'for all allies'. 'in the current battle' is 'permanent': true -- the buff is never ticked, so its duration is unbounded rather than merely long. 'This effect cannot stack' again falls out of the default replace-on-same-kind behaviour.
